full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiff, in short, is that the properties as shown in Ka schedule of the plaint appertaining to CS Khatian No. 263 and 381 originally, was held by Jahar Uddin having 8 annas share, Ziaullah and Jamil Masud having 4 annas, each under the superior landlord and they were in ejmali possession of the suit jot and while possessing the same, Jaharuddin died leaving behind one son plaintiff  No. 1. Sona Bibi died leaving behind full sister, Sundari Bewa and thereafter Sundari Bewa died leaving behind two sons, defendant Nos. 2 and 3 and one daughter defendant No. 1. The daughter of Sundari Bewa died before her mother, leaving behind one daughter and Galimuddin died leaving behind two daughters, Sakhina and Sakeron. One of the daughters died leaving behind one son plaintiff No.3, and, on the death of Amena, her share devolved upon her full sister, thereafter Sakhina died leaving her daughter, plaintiff No. 2 and there after Ziaullah died leaving one son Ilyasuddin and one daughter Menerunnessa. Elimuddin during his life time settled 66 decimals of land from plot Nos. 1 and 2 of Ka schedule and Kha schedule properties by a registered patta dated 9-2-1945 to plaintiff No. 1 and he has been possessing the land since then but the original patta was lost during the War of Liberation.
